mapper.insert: INSERT INTO operation_logs_statistics ( statistic_date, module, operation_type, user_count, operation_count, success_count, fail_count, created_at, updated_at ) SELECT DATE(created_at) AS statistic_date, module, operation_type, COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) AS user_count, COUNT(*) AS operation_count, SUM(CASE WHEN operation_result = '成功' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS success_count, SUM(CASE WHEN operation_result = '失败' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS fail_count, NOW() AS created_at, NOW() AS updated_at FROM operation_logs WHERE is_deleted = 0 AND DATE(created_at) = DATE(#{statisticDate}) GROUP BY DATE(created_at), module, operation_type
mapper.update: UPDATE operation_logs_statistics SET is_deleted = 1, updated_at = NOW() WHERE statistic_date < #{expiryDate} AND is_deleted = 0
